point.title: Checkpoint and Catalog Persistence
point.rationale: Persistence separates immutable content and checkpoint records from mutable manifests and published catalog entries. Browser changes become incremental record batches with version checks and retry identities; server stores publish references after backing records exist. This boundary supports durable history, efficient current-state reads, publication, and atomic acceptance of multi-canvas changes.
